name: Theme Modal UI
description: Theme modal DOM and interactions. Documents the modal overlay structure with two radio button groups (THEMES and LIGHT/DARK), Apply and Cancel buttons, Escape key dismissal, overlay click dismissal, re-render on open to sync radio state, and open/closed visual states.

dom.root: .modal-overlay (display:none by default, display:flex when open — full-viewport fixed overlay with semi-transparent dark background)

elements.overlay: div.modal-overlay — full-viewport overlay with click-to-dismiss (clicks on children do not dismiss via e.target === this.overlay check)
elements.modal: div.modal (role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-label=Theme) — centered modal card
elements.body: div.modal-body — content container wrapping sections and actions
elements.themes_section: div.modal-section — first section: div.modal-label ('THEMES' label) + two label.modal-radio elements containing input[type=radio][name=theme-base] with values 'default' (text: Default) and 'monokai' (text: Monokai), checked attribute set to match theme.base
elements.mode_section: div.modal-section — second section: div.modal-label ('LIGHT / DARK' label) + two label.modal-radio elements containing input[type=radio][name=theme-mode] with values 'dark' (text: Dark) and 'light' (text: Light), checked attribute set to match theme.mode
elements.actions: div.modal-actions — button row at bottom of modal body

interactions.name: apply
interactions.action: Read checked input[name='theme-base']:checked value → read checked input[name='theme-mode']:checked value → if both are truthy: theme.setTheme(base, mode) → close() (hide overlay, remove Escape listener, fire onCloseCb)
interactions.result: Theme applied to document via theme singleton CSS custom properties; modal closed; onClose callback invoked

interactions.name: cancel
interactions.trigger: click on #theme-cancel button, OR Escape keydown (when overlay is visible), OR click on .modal-overlay background (e.target === this.overlay)
interactions.action: close() → overlay display:none → remove Escape keydown listener from document → fire stored onCloseCb → null onCloseCb
interactions.result: Modal dismissed without applying theme changes; onClose callback invoked; Escape listener removed

states.open: Overlay display:flex, modal visible and centered. Radio buttons checked to match current theme.base and theme.mode values (set during this.render() call at start of open()). Escape keydown listener registered on document. onClose callback stored.
states.closed: Overlay display:none, modal hidden. Escape keydown listener removed from document. onCloseCb nulled after firing.

lifecycle.created_by: App constructor — ThemeModal instance created once, overlay appended to document.body and hidden
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Overlay element remains in DOM across open/close cycles; display toggled only. Instance lives for renderer process duration.
